paragraphs.text: Jenna Helland (1975) is a writer and a former Magic creative designer for Wizards of the Coast .

She started working for the company in 2007. In 2014, Jenna became the manager of the Creative team of R&D . Jenna left Wizards in August 2021. As a self-employed Narrative Designer and writer she did project-based creative work for clients such as Ravensburger, Wizards of the Coast, and Insight Editions.
